# hosttracker_locations (Data Source)

The monitoring locations and the pools they belong to. A monitor's `locations.pools` takes pool ids from here; `["allworld"]` means everywhere. The filters narrow the agent list only - the pool list is always the whole tree.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hosttracker_locations" "all" {}

# Locations that can run a ping check from Germany.
data "hosttracker_locations" "german_icmp" {
  country    = ["Germany"]
  capability = ["icmp"]
}

output "pool_ids" {
  value = data.hosttracker_locations.all.pool_ids
}

# The addresses those locations check from, for a firewall allow-list.
output "german_egress_ips" {
  value = [for a in data.hosttracker_locations.german_icmp.agents : a.ip if a.ip != null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `capability` (Set of String) Keep only locations offering all of these capabilities: `icmp` (ping and trace), `browser` (the Waterfall fleet), `internal`.
- `country` (Set of String) Keep only locations in these countries, matched case-insensitively.
- `pool` (Set of String) Keep only locations belonging to any of these pools.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (List of String) The matched locations' ids, in the order the API returned them.
- `agents` (Attributes List) The matched monitoring locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `pool_ids` (List of String) Every pool id, in the order the API returned them.
- `pools` (Attributes List) The pool tree. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (List of String) What this location can check: `icmp`, `browser`, `internal`.
- `city` (String) The city.
- `country` (String) The country.
- `id` (String) The location id, as `locations.excluded_agents` takes it.
- `ip` (String) The address this location's checks go out from - what an allow-list entry for it looks like.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether this location can reach IPv6 targets. A capability, not an address.
- `lat` (Number) Latitude.
- `lon` (Number) Longitude.
- `name` (String) The label, `"Country, State, City"`.
- `pools` (List of String) The pools this location belongs to.
- `region` (String) The first-level administrative division the city sits in.
- `version` (String) The agent build running there.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether this location is offered in a location picker.


<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `children` (List of String) Nested pool ids.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the pool is offered in a picker. A hidden pool is still selectable.
- `id` (String) The pool id, as `locations.pools` takes it.
- `name` (String) The human name.
- `parents` (List of String) Pools that contain this one.
- `priority` (Number) The pool's ordering weight, ascending.
